public_rationale: The firm part of the claim is that hallucinations had not disappeared by mid-2024, and it holds. In May 2024, Stanford researchers found that commercial legal AI tools sold as avoiding hallucinations still gave wrong information on more than 17% to 34% of queries. In late July 2024, OpenAI's SearchGPT gave wrong festival dates in its own launch demo. The 'inevitable byproduct' part is hedged ('as far as I can tell') and is treated as opinion, not scored.
limitations: Only the 'yet to disappear' part is scored.
The evidence covers selected products and domains.
